prompts.contact-card-surface-v2: Reference image role: visual-material reference only; do not edit it. Create a production-ready reusable UI surface asset for a private relationship-care contact directory. Scene/backdrop: one completely blank, wide horizontal personal correspondence card, 3.2:1 landscape composition, matching the reference's pearl-white mineral glass, mist aqua, pale cobalt edge accents, subtle organic translucent layers. Key details: extremely quiet low-contrast center for dark Chinese UI text; a faint concentric echo-ring detail near the upper-right; soft mineral fold only along the far edges; refined 14px-corner-friendly silhouette; gentle offset depth and fine internal highlight; consistent enough to be reused behind every contact. Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no people, no faces, no avatar, no icon, no button, no checkbox, no chat bubble, no logo, no watermark, no mock UI; no strong center texture; no baked shadows outside the card; full-bleed rectangular asset, no transparency required. Output intent: shippable shared Web UI background asset, clean, understated Apple-level polish, optimized visually for legible data over it.
